photovoltaic.def: A photovoltaic (PV) cell turns sunlight directly into electricity, with no moving parts; many cells make a solar panel.

passive-solar.def: Heating and lighting a building with the sun through its design alone: sun-facing windows, overhangs and thick walls or floors that store heat, with no pumps or fans.

active-solar.def: Solar systems that use equipment such as pumps, fans or mirrors to collect and move the sun's heat, including rooftop water heaters and concentrated solar power plants.

intermittency.def: The property of an energy source that is not available all the time, such as solar at night or wind on calm days; it means storage or backup is needed.
